items: Three new modules: In Order (planets, life cycles, layers of the Earth — tap the steps into place), Chemical Elements, and Frases Cortas, twenty small Spanish sentences read by a Spanish voice.
A clearer default font, Atkinson Hyperlegible, made to be easy to read. Settings lets you pick another.
When Google Drive sync is on, your Google picture and name show beside "synced", so you can see whose account a shared tablet is using.
Erase everything on this device works again, and now also disconnects Drive here. Your copy in Drive is left alone. It is not offered in kid mode.
Ask a tutor: advice from the study coach now waits for you to look it over before it is shown, and can be undone.
Review due now asks each card the way you have earned: new cards as a choice, newer ones with a blank, old friends from memory.
Order it: put the steps of a sequence in the right order.
Say it, for French: hear the answer, say it yourself, and see which words came out.
The grade buttons say when a card would come back, and a card can show the shape of its answer as a hint.
A wrong typed answer is shown letter by letter, and "not today" puts a card off until tomorrow.
In the last three days before a deadline, every card is asked once more.
A high-contrast look, a picture search for cards, and room for far more pictures.
